node.title: CGI package recommendation
node.author: BernieC
node.doctext: I last did a CGIed website something like 25 years ago -- AJAX was _just_ becoming popular! At the time I just used CGI.pm. I now would like to do another -- it is for a simple [but CGIed] site.. I don't need AJAX or a DB interface or the like. Is there a better/more modern package for that kind of thing than just CGI.pm {NB: I remember almost nothing about using CGI.pm -- it's been a long time :) so I'd have to start by studying the POD docs anyway, so if there's something newer/easier/better I'd be happy to try it.}
